doc: Zone number of each row: floor(_earth_lat / 5).astype(int) (floor, then a truncating cast: non-negative here), so zones 0..13, the cap rows all in 13. No latitude sits within 1e-4 of a zone edge (a tie would depend on the last bit of degrees()), apart from exact 0 and the capped 65. A slow rotator (edge at 60 degrees): the zones cover half the globe's span, none reach the cap. Rows: a 64-row grid then the poles pulled in by 1e-3 rad (|lat| = 90 would sit exactly on a zone edge for this edge), the equator, +-0.0, 1e-9, 0.5, 1.2, 1.5 rad.
